{{Quote|685 to Command: There's too many of them. They've overrun the base. We need reinforcements!|685's last words|<ref name="Trespass">{{TCW|Trespass}}</ref>}}
'''685''' was a [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]] used by [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], which was stationed on a base on a frozen planet [[Orto Plutonia/Legends|Orto Plutonia]].

==Biography==
[[File:TheDoomThatCameTo685-Trespass.png|thumb|left|180px|685 about to be attacked by a [[Talz/Legends|Talz]].]]
The activity of the CIS droids provoked the planet's native [[Talz/Legends|Talz]] to attack them, wiping out the entire base with nothing but bare hands and [[Spear/Legends|spears]]. 685 was one of the last droids standing; he requested assistance before being ultimately smashed by a Talz warrior. When Jedi [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] came to investigate the base on the assumption that Separatists were involved in a recent slaughter of clone troops at the nearby [[Glid Station/Legends|Glid Station]], they found a holorecord of 685's last moments detailing what became of the droid.<ref name="Trespass" />
